posts.subject: Demande d'information sur le Legion pro 27q-10 Oled sur le systeme Oled Care
posts.author: Miysis56
posts.message_html:
Hello,

I recently bought a Lenovo Legion Pro 27q10 monitor and it does not indicate the automatic features of the monitor regarding screen protections.

After unsuccessfully trying to contact support, and its chat which keeps redirecting us in a loop... I'm trying to get answers here.

The chat tells me that pixel protection can start automatically, but under what conditions? After sleep? For how long? True or false?

Or is it only manual via the OSD menu?

Thank you

posts.subject: Re:Request for information about the Legion Pro 27q-10 OLED on the OLED Care system
posts.author: Lorenzo_Lenovo
posts.message_html:
Hello Miysis56,

Welcome to Lenovo Community

I understand that you are looking for the information about the Legion Pro 27q-10 OLED Care system and screen protections.
About OLED Care and automatic protections:
Lenovo OLED monitors generally include several protections under the OSD “OLED Care” (names may vary): pixel/Panel Cleaning, Screen Move (pixel shift), Logo Luminance Adjustment, and Screen Saver.
Short “Pixel Cleaning” routines usually run automatically when the monitor enters standby or is powered off after use, while a longer compensation cycle can be started manually from the OSD. Exact trigger conditions (timers/durations) can vary by firmware and model.
You can always run the routine manually from the OSD if you prefer not to wait for the automatic cycle.
As for this model, it seems that it is manually configured via the OSD. See page 2-9 of the monitor user guide.
Hope this helps.

Best regards,
Lorenzo_Lenovo

topic_info.message:
Bonjour,

J'ai recement acheter un ecran lenovo legion pro 27q10 et il n'est pas indiquer les automatismes de l'ecan en ceux qu'il concerne les protection d'ecran.

Apres avoir en vain essayer de contacter le support, et son chat qui nour redirige en boucle... Je viens essayer d'avoir des reponses ici.

Le chat me dit que la protection des pixel peu se lancer de facon automatique, mais dans quel condition ? apres une veille ? de combien de temps ? vrai ou faux ? 

Ou c'est juste de facon manuelle via le menu de l'OSD ?

En vous remerciant
